_comment: LOCAL EMULATOR ONLY (spec 037 section 7.3). Never used for deployment.
Deliberately separate from firebase.json so the deploy config and the synthetic-UID rules
copies can never be mixed up. There is no hosting block here on purpose.
Run with BOTH flags: --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-denn-emulator
The demo- project prefix is what guarantees no real credentials can be reached.
